label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Some good news to start with: Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November. She's a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) with nine years at a consultancy in Coventry, and she's going to take a real load off the work that's been piling up.

I want to be straight with you about the last couple of months. Some of you waited far too long for your beam calculations and drawings. In September and October the turnaround stretched to five or six weeks, which wasn't good enough, and some of you were rightly unhappy about it. One of you left a sharp review, and fair enough. The slow weeks were my doing. I kept saying yes to more work than one person could properly handle, doing site visits by day and calculations until midnight, and things slipped. I'm sorry.

Here's where we're heading. Our target for beam calculations and drawings is now 10 working days, and with Priya on board I'm confident we can hold it.

If you're waiting on a job right now, it's moving. Please message me directly and I'll give you a straight answer on where it stands. The couple in Harborne whose builder was left standing with steel ordered got their calculations in three days, but only after chasing us twice. That shouldn't happen, and I'd much rather you didn't have to chase.

One change to tell you about. From 1 January 2027, first site visits will cost £95. If you go ahead with the job, that £95 comes off your fee. We've offered the visit free for a while, and it was a nice thing to do, but about a third of visits never turned into work, and that time was being taken from the people who did go ahead. Any visit already booked when this post goes up stays free, whatever its date.

Finally, if you see Priya on site, please say hello. She's joining a practice that's been through a rough patch, and a warm welcome from our clients would mean a lot to her.
